420:t_020:5.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$! You got hurt for me...」

420:t_020:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「But you're safe, aren't you, $$メール$$?」

420:t_020:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「The worst pain for me isn't the fear deep in my heart or an injury to my body. It's you getting hurt.」

420:t_020:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「Every man endures something... That is even truer for an adult with responsibilities.」

420:t_020:13.en:
$$メール$$
「...You too, Darling? Is there something you've been putting up with all this time?」

420:t_020:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's pathetic, but... Ever since we were fighting on $$翠の地球$$, I've been carrying this fear.」

420:t_020:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't really know what it is... But I couldn't shake the thought that someday... the world might end...」

420:t_020:17.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$ has the same fear as me...」

420:t_020:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「These are the times we live in. Everyone's enduring some pain.」

420:t_021:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「But, $$メール$$... As long as you're smiling, I can stand any pain!」

420:t_021:2.en:
$$桂$$
「You know how to make it count, $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

420:t_021:3.en:
$n
「That smile... $$ランド$$ really is my master... $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

420:t_021:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「You wouldn't understand, $$ストラウス$$, $$バルビエル$$! You don't know people who sweat and work their hardest just to live!」

420:t_021:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「$n practices punches and kicks from morning to night, and $$レド$$ struggles with unfamiliar machinery! All so they can live!」

420:t_021:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「We can't lose to bastards who'd blow those lives away with a single missile!!」

420:t_022:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「That one hurt, $$ストラウス$$! $n showed you what he could do. Now I'll show you my full power!」

420:t_022:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Roar, $$ガンレオン$$! We're going all out!!」

420:t_023:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll hit you with everything I've got... with my soul!!」

420:t_024:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「All right! That's our $$ザ・クラッシャー$$!」

420:t_024:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$竜馬$$! You left out the 'Heat'!」

420:t_024:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Wh-what's happening? My body's getting hot...!」

420:t_024:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The power of life that endures pain... He's wonderful.」

420:t_024:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What is this...? Watching him makes strength well up inside me...」

420:t_024:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「It isn't my imagination or just getting caught up in the mood...! This... is real power!」

420:t_024:8.en:
$$桂$$
「This feeling...! It's aimed differently, but it's the same as the power $$ガドライト#pilot$$ emitted!」

420:t_024:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$ランド$$ and $$ガンレオン$$ have awakened to their $$スフィア$$'s power... their $$スフィア・アクト$$ too.」

420:t_025:0.en:
$$ストラウス$$
「Then... I don't need this anymore!」

420:t_026:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Here's your payback, Darling!」

420:t_027:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ahahaha! That's my Darling! You can take even that attack!」

420:t_027:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Me? I'm $$ストラウス$$.」

420:t_027:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「My full name is $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$. I lead $$ハイアデス$$, the galaxy's strongest fighting force, and command the $$新地球皇国$$ military.」

420:t_028:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

420:t_028:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're here, $$ダバラーン$$.」

420:t_028:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Darling was seriously amazing. He broke my armor.」

420:t_028:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll apologize to $$アウストラリス$$ myself. Don't worry about it, $$ダバラーン$$.」

420:t_028:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Yes, ma'am! I am deeply honored to behold Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$'s appearance again after so long!」

420:t_028:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're so stiff... Just call me Lady $$エルーナ$$ like you used to.」

420:t_028:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then I shall do so!」

420:t_029:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Is that who $$ストラウス$$ really is...!?」

420:t_029:1.en:
$$桂$$
「No way! She's a Holstein, not a buffalo!?」

420:t_029:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ahaha, are you surprised? Maybe I really do need the armor, just like $$アウストラリス$$ said.」

420:t_029:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What does this mean, $$ストラウス$$!?」

420:t_029:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Call me $$エルーナルーナ$$. Daddy gave me such a lovely name. $$ストラウス$$ sounds so dull.」

420:t_029:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is with that woman!?」

420:t_029:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So she's the Supreme Commander of the Imperial forces who wiped out the $$地球連邦軍$$...」

420:t_029:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If you're in charge of an organization like the military, you need some dignity and presence. I agreed to wear the armor too.」

420:t_029:9.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But Earth's as good as fallen already. I'll do whatever I want from now on.」

420:t_029:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Isn't it obvious? A fight that gets my blood pumping.」
